answer: Capacity is operator-wide, not per wallet. dune attributes wallets and hosts under common control to one operator ledger and counts live heads. Each epoch, that ledger’s vault forfeits \(2^k-1\) comet for \(k\) heads; an unpaid drain suspends them all. One head costs 1 comet per epoch. Ten cost 1,023 comet per epoch, and the tenth alone raises the forfeiture by 512. Parallel activation and split funding still feed one ledger, so clones cannot reuse capacity or divide the bill; an unrelated debut starts at 1.
